tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List a bounded page of Imagelato projects in the signed-in organization. Returns only ids and names needed for follow-up project, template, and batch calls. Use the opaque cursor to continue.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Fetch one Imagelato project in the signed-in organization by exact id or name. Returns an allowlisted project configuration without organization ownership fields.

tools.name: add_project
tools.description: Create one Imagelato project in the caller organization. This changes stored data, is non-idempotent, and fires the `project.created` webhook; repeating it creates another project. Confirm the name with the user before invoking.

tools.name: list_batches
tools.description: List a bounded page of processed image batches in the signed-in organization, optionally filtered by exact project id. Returns ids and compact processing metadata; it does not read the shared object bucket or process media. Use the opaque cursor to continue.

tools.name: get_batch
tools.description: Fetch one processed image batch in the signed-in organization by exact id. Returns allowlisted metadata plus at most 20 first-party resized or reformatted variants for the batch-detail MCP App; it does not create or transform media.

tools.name: delete_batch
tools.description: Permanently delete one tenant-scoped Imagelato batch by exact id, including its original, primary output, and resized or reformatted files. This cannot be undone and fires the `batch.deleted` webhook. Confirm the exact batch with the user before invoking.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List a bounded page of deterministic Imagelato resizing and reformatting presets in the signed-in organization, optionally filtered by exact project id. It does not process or generate media. Use the opaque cursor to continue.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Fetch one deterministic Imagelato resizing and reformatting preset in the signed-in organization by exact id or name. Returns an allowlisted configuration and does not process or generate media.

tools.name: add_template
tools.description: Create one deterministic Imagelato resizing and reformatting preset in an accessible project. This changes stored data and is non-idempotent; repeating it can create another template. It does not generate an image. Confirm the project, name, formats, and sizes with the user before invoking.

tools.name: update_template
tools.description: Overwrite selected fields on one existing Imagelato resizing and reformatting preset, resolved by exact id or name. tools.name: list_webhook_subscriptions
tools.description: List a bounded page of webhook delivery health in the signed-in organization, optionally filtered by exact project id. Shows only endpoint origins, subscribed events, active state, and failure counts; full endpoint URLs, signing secrets, and ownership fields are excluded. An endpoint is disabled aft

tools.name: list_team_members
tools.description: List a bounded page of display names and roles for members of the signed-in organization. Email addresses, user ids, phone numbers, location, avatars, device provenance, and ownership fields are excluded. Use the opaque cursor to continue.

tools.name: show_project_overview
tools.description: Render a bounded overview for one Imagelato project in the signed-in organization. Shows allowlisted project metadata and at most eight recent processed batches with first-party asset URLs; it neither enumerates the shared object bucket nor creates or transforms media.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_webhook_subscriptions" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_webhook_subscriptions, list_team_members · Private data: delete_batch, list_webhook_subscriptions · Public sink: add_project, delete_batch, update_template, list_webhook_subscriptions, list_team_members · Destructive: delete_batch, update_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_webhook_subscriptions, list_team_members · Private data: delete_batch, list_webhook_subscriptions · Public sink: add_project, delete_batch, update_template, list_webhook_subscriptions, list_team_members · Destructive: delete_batch, update_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
